name: Yorii (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Yorii town emblem in maroon: a broken ring enclosing a stylised character of horizontal strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Yorii, a town in Saitama Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 25 May 1982.

features.role: Yorii town emblem — a broken ring enclosing a stylised character of horizontal strokes
